scope: Hackathon prototype. Drafts are shown only to an authenticated clinician and require explicit clinician confirmation.
decision: Blocked after the reproducible held-out engineering check. The adapter passed the partner-medication mention rule in 7 of 18 cases and the clarification rule in 17 of 18 cases. It remains available only as a local training artifact until a new independent evaluation and clinician review are complete.
knownLimitations: The small synthetic dataset does not establish clinical accuracy.
The model can misread individual fields; the application computes medication eligibility outside the model.
Generated text is a draft and must not be sent to a patient or treated as a prescription.
The inspected test set must not be reused as a fresh independent holdout after further tuning.
